prompt: Gold sells hot soup on a cold day
title: Hot Soup Day
irony: Gold the penny-pincher who charges extra for everything only fills his diner on a cold day by giving his hot soup away free.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green and Navy shiver in the snow outside Gold's glowing diner as soup steam curls up.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green drags Navy into the diner for hot soup while Gold counts coins and warns extras cost more.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Purple's truck toots across the road and draws the shivering lunch crowd away from Gold's door.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant for hot soup as Pink ladles steaming bowls for the cold crowd.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Gold charges extra for each topping while Silver slips on ice and spills soup across the floor.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Jade dares to gulp her boiling bowl in one go while Navy laughs and Pink fans her red face.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The diner crowd chants for hot soup again as frost feathers across the cold windows.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold watches coinless Silver shiver outside and feels his stingy heart soften with shame.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides all soup is free today as Green cheers and Pink hangs a free-soup sign.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crowd chants the hook as Gold himself sings that free soup warms best of all.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Gold ladles free soup for Silver and Purple too as the whole diner glows warm together.
